text:
matt: Postmortem for P0 (ACME auth outage) — need a facilitator and a 30–45m slot this week. Customer-facing summary and timeline are in the doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/p0-acme-auth
sana: I can help coordinate invites, but need someone to chair and take notes. timezone-wise: ACME is PST heavy, engineering is mostly ET/EU.
jamie: I can chair if no one else wants it. Prefer Thu morning ET (11:00 ET) — that hits PST afternoon and also OK for EU at 16:00-ish.
leo: I'm +1 for Jamie chairing. I did the initial RCA notes and can present the mitigation timeline.
oncall-bot: Incident P0-AUTH resolved. Postmortem doc created by leo: https://redwood.internal/notes/p0-acme-auth — add attendees with @oncall to include logs and runbook links.
erin: Thu 11:00 ET works for me. If Jamie can chair, I can bring the customer impact numbers and be backup scribe.
matt: Thanks — Jamie, would you take chair? If yes, Sana will send invites and include the pre-read and action tracker.
jamie: I can chair. I'll take the opening 5m summary and we can go through timeline -> root cause -> mitigation -> action items. Prefer 45m to allow discussion.
sana: Scheduling for Thu 11:00 ET / 08:00 PT / 16:00 CET, 45m. I'll set the invite and include pre-read + agenda. Who else should I add? @security, @support-lead?
leo: Add @support-lead (Maya) and @platform-ops (Ravi). Also include the engineer owners: @erin, @matt, @leo.
oncall-bot: Reminder: attach runbook excerpt and logs to the event; use channel #incidents for live notes.
erin: Quick ask — can we make the meeting recorder optional? customer legal may want archive but not public. Jamie, ok to record but keep transcript internal?
jamie: Fine to record, will only share with invited stakeholders. Sana please mark recording permissions private.
matt: Action for prework: everyone add one bullet to the pre-read by Wed EOD: measurable impact, one-sentence mitigation, one proposed action.
sana: Invite sent to the list + Maya + Ravi. Calendar title: "P0 ACME Auth postmortem (chair: jamie)". Pre-read link & agenda attached.
leo: Thanks. I'll drop a short timeline and the mitigation logs in the doc now.
erin: I'll paste the customer impact table and the ticket references into the doc by tomorrow.
jamie: Great. I'll pull together the action tracker template and assign tentative owners after the meeting.
matt: Thanks all. If anyone can't make Thu 11:00 ET, speak up now so we can reschedule.
leo: All good for me.
erin: good.
sana: all set :thumbsup:
matt: closing — facilitator assigned (jamie), invite sent, pre-read due Wed EOD. We'll use #incidents for live notes and oncall-bot will pin the doc."
